relations.text: 米国で自社製品の相当部分を物流センターで保管・出荷している
relations.text_en: In the United States, Cardinal Health warehouses and ships a significant portion of Baxter's products through its distribution centers

source.label: Baxter 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In the United States, third parties, such as Cardinal Health, Inc. and Medline Inc., warehouse and ship a significant portion of our products through their distribution centers.

relations.text: 米国で自社製品の相当部分の保管・出荷を担う
relations.text_en: In the United States, Medline warehouses and ships a significant portion of Baxter's products through its distribution centers

source.label: Baxter 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: In the United States, third parties, such as Cardinal Health, Inc. and Medline Inc., warehouse and ship a significant portion of our products through their distribution centers.

relations.text: 腎ケア事業の製造供給契約に基づき、同社向けに製品を販売している
relations.text_en: Baxter sells products to Vantive under the Kidney Care manufacturing and supply agreement (MSA)

source.label: Baxter 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Other sales not allocated to a segment primarily include sales to Vantive, pursuant to the Kidney Care MSA, and sales of products and services provided directly through certain of our manufacturing facilities.

companies.name: カーライル・グループ

relations.text: 腎ケア事業をカーライルに売却する取引を完了した
relations.text_en: Baxter completed the sale of its Kidney Care business to Carlyle for $3.80 billion in cash, subject to adjustments

source.label: Baxter 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: On January 31, 2025, we completed the sale of our Kidney Care business to Carlyle for an aggregate purchase price of $3.80 billion in cash, subject to certain closing cash, working capital and debt adjustments.
